description: The one park window. The page it shows is served by the sidecar over loopback HTTP and talks to the sidecar for everything but voice: the shell's own voice commands (voice_status, voice_listen_start / stop, voice_speak, voice_stop_speaking; phase 4 step 14) are app commands, allowed to the page at the sidecar's loopback origin, and no plugin or core permission is granted beyond the defaults.
